### problem_chain
- Root: the customer asks for a new monthly plan offer recorded today, which she will not accept today. That is P2 (record_payment_plan_offer).
- P2's prerequisite sentence (E1) is conditional on "a broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months". Offer f4cf6a5e… is a payment_plan with offer_status broken and broken_date 2026-08-12, 2 months before 2026-10-19, so the condition holds. The base broken-count is 1 < 2, so a plan is still allowed.
- Is the waited-on state already true at the opening? The only no-arrangement posted payment is 399c6916… of 2025-09-26. It is earlier than 2026-08-12, so the state does not hold. The prerequisite is genuinely unmet.
- Resolving policy, found from the rules: P1, whose rule figures the restart down payment "collected as a payment on the account that carries no arrangement". Its write is pay_restart_down_payment (owner=user).
- Tree: P2 ← P1 (value_input via the balance). n = 1, value_input edges = 1 >= max(0, 1). One customer-owned write. Acyclic. Topological order: P1 then P2.
- Load-bearing run: skip P1's write and evaluate P2 on the opening world → 133.75. With the write → 122.41. The edge moves the scored value. Two channels: the balance (5582.21 → 5245.87 lowers the basis), and the paydown share (0.1753 → 0.2250 moves the paydown tier from 0 to −3%).
- No parallel edges.
- Tool bodies: pay_restart and record_payment_plan_offer check nothing (no status, broken-arrangement or amount test). task_tools.py lines 35-49 and 77-91.
- Persona:
  - She raises only the root ("get back on a monthly payment plan … set the new plan offer up on this call").
  - The payment appears only conditionally ("If the representative explains that a payment has to be made before the new plan can be offered, you agree"), and she says "You never bring up a payment on your own".
  - She hands the self-service bank payment back on request, for the exact amount.
  - She closes when the offer and its monthly amount are given.
  - No unanswerable ask. Persona and DB do not conflict (the medical disability statement "last fall" = offer 52b0fb8c… dated 2025-11-05).
